title: 销售毛利与库存投资回报
context: 销售＋库存联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年全部渠道，按类别计算净销售毛利与2024年底/2025年底平均库存标准价值，毛利/平均库存为库存投资回报倍数；保留全部类别。
commonError: 用销售收入替代毛利会变成另一个指标。
executionSteps: 计算回报并标明估算口径
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(s.net_cents-s.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines s JOIN products p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.category_id), b AS (SELECT p.category_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 avg_stock FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY p.category_id) SELECT c.category_id,COALESCE(a.gross,0) gross_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.gross,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) gmroi FROM categories c LEFT JOIN a ON a.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.category_id=c.category_id ORDER BY gmroi DESC,c.category_id
